description: This file defines a custom attribute class 'RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterAttribute' used for specifying placement filtering based on silo metadata key-value pairs in Orleans. It includes metadata annotations and inherits from a placement filter attribute.

classes.name: RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterAttribute
classes.description: An attribute class used to specify that a silo must have specific metadata key-value pairs for placement filtering in Orleans.

methods.name: RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterAttribute
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the attribute with specified metadata keys and an optional order.
